items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: So when the Armstrong band needed a bass player, I put Arvell Shaw in there.

ctx.x: How did you come in contact with him? How did you know about his musical ability?

Well, being in St. Louis with Jeter-Pillars, we had our own bass player but I've always known Arvell because he'd be in some of the sessions. He played with all the bands around St. Louis, he had a big reputation. He's a good bass player. So when the Armstrong band needed a bass player, I put Arvell Shaw in there.
